name: DatetimeToConvert
label: Datetime to Convert
description: The datetime value to convert to text.

name: FormatToUse
label: Format to Use
description: Specifies whether to use a standard datetime format or create a custom one.

selectOptions.label: Standard Format
selectOptions.description: Uses one of the predefined date/time formats.

selectOptions.label: Custom Format
selectOptions.description: Allows defining a custom date/time pattern.

name: StandardFormat
label: Standard Format
description: The standard datetime format to use when displaying the datetime value.

selectOptions.label: Short Date
selectOptions.description: Displays a short date pattern, such as MM/dd/yyyy.

selectOptions.label: Long Date
selectOptions.description: Displays a long date pattern, such as 'Wednesday, January 1, 2025'.

selectOptions.label: Short Time
selectOptions.description: Displays a short time pattern, such as hh:mm tt.

selectOptions.label: Long Time
selectOptions.description: Displays a long time pattern, such as hh:mm:ss tt.

selectOptions.label: Full Date, Short Time
selectOptions.description: Displays the full date and short time, such as 'Monday, January 1, 2025 3:45 PM'.

selectOptions.label: Full Date, Long Time
selectOptions.description: Displays the full date and long time, such as 'Monday, January 1, 2025 3:45:00 PM'.

selectOptions.label: General Date, Short Time
selectOptions.description: General date with short time format.

selectOptions.label: General Date, Long Time
selectOptions.description: General date with long time format.

selectOptions.label: Sortable Datetime
selectOptions.description: A locale-independent sorted date-time format. ISO 8601 compatible.

name: CustomFormat
label: Custom Format
description: A custom format string for formatting the datetime value (e.g., yyyyMMdd).

name: FormattedDateTime
label: Formatted DateTime
description: The formatted datetime as a text value.
